title: China-to-Bangladesh Industrial Motor Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Motor Product Class and BDS / IEC 60034 Alignment
rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh treats covered industrial AC motors through BSTI product standards and certification routes. BDS motor standards adopt or align with IEC 60034 for rotating electrical machines, so the target technical file should map model, rated output, poles, duty, insulation class, enclosure, nameplate data and test evidence to the applicable BDS or IEC 60034 basis.
target_standards: BSTI mandatory certification scheme for covered products
Applicable Bangladesh Standards BDS for electric motors
IEC 60034 series as adopted or aligned in BDS
rows.china_equivalent: China suppliers commonly hold GB 18613 efficiency evidence, GB 12665 cooling evidence and CCC certificates for low-voltage motors in CCC scope. These materials help identify the product class and performance basis but do not replace Bangladesh BDS or BSTI conformity review.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The technical class may be similar because both sides refer toward IEC 60034 concepts, but the approval route is local. A China GB or CCC file should be translated into a Bangladesh BDS/BSTI submission matrix and checked against the exact covered-product list.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when the motor is a covered product under BSTI mandatory certification
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where GB 18613, GB 12665 and CCC scope apply in China

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat IEC 60034 alignment as a mapping aid, not a market approval. Confirm BSTI coverage and prepare Bangladesh-specific BDS evidence before shipment.

rows.target_requirement: Common industrial three-phase AC motors should be scoped by rated voltage, frequency, output range, duty, protection, cooling method and intended industrial use. Bangladesh uses a 400/230 V, 50 Hz three-phase supply environment, so a China 380 V, 50 Hz motor needs explicit rating and tolerance review for Bangladesh operation.
target_standards: BDS standards for rotating electrical machines as applicable
IEC 60034 nameplate, rating and performance concepts
Bangladesh 400/230 V, 50 Hz grid practice
rows.china_equivalent: China common industrial motor evidence uses GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes, GB 12665 for cooling and CCC for low-voltage motors in scope. China domestic three-phase motors are commonly specified around 380 V, 50 Hz, which shares frequency with Bangladesh but differs from Bangladesh's 400 V three-phase nominal voltage.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: Frequency is aligned at 50 Hz, reducing redesign risk. The remaining class gap is voltage and rating evidence: the motor nameplate and test file should support 400 V operation or state an acceptable voltage range for Bangladesh installations.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory practical scoping for BSTI certification and grid fit where covered
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China domestic GB and CCC requirements apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Bangladesh uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the 400 V three-phase nominal system should be checked against any China 380 V motor rating before quoting or shipping.

rows.requirement: IE Efficiency Class Direction under BSTI Programmes
rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh energy-efficiency labelling and standards activity for motors is under BSTI programmes and BDS standards that follow the IEC 60034-30-1 IE-class direction. Exporters should document the declared IE class, efficiency test method, rated load points and model family grouping for Bangladesh review.
target_standards: BSTI energy-efficiency labelling programmes
Applicable BDS motor efficiency standards
IEC 60034-30-1 IE efficiency class direction
rows.china_equivalent: China GB 18613 defines mandatory motor energy-efficiency grades aligned in direction with IEC 60034-30-1 IE classes. China suppliers commonly present GB 18613 test reports and China energy-efficiency label evidence, supported by GB 12665 cooling evidence and CCC where applicable.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The IE terminology is directionally compatible, but Bangladesh acceptance depends on BSTI and applicable BDS review. Do not assume a China GB 18613 report or China label is automatically sufficient for Bangladesh labelling or certification.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where BSTI energy-efficiency labelling or covered product certification applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory under GB 18613 for covered China domestic motor scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Use China GB 18613 evidence as input, then confirm the exact BSTI and BDS efficiency or labelling route for the Bangladesh model family.

rows.requirement: Energy Label Evidence for Covered Motors
rows.target_requirement: For motors covered by Bangladesh energy-efficiency labelling programmes, the importer should hold BSTI-facing evidence for the claimed efficiency class and label content. The file should connect test reports, nameplate ratings, model identifiers and declared IE class to the Bangladesh-labelled article.
target_standards: BSTI energy-efficiency labelling programmes
Applicable BDS standards for labelled motor products
IEC 60034-2-1 and IEC 60034-30-1 concepts where adopted
rows.china_equivalent: China motor shipments may include China energy-efficiency label records and GB 18613 reports. Those records are useful for performance traceability but are market-specific China evidence rather than a Bangladesh energy label approval.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The label gap is procedural and evidentiary. China label data should be rebuilt into a Bangladesh label file with the exact imported model, local rating, language or format expectations and importer responsibility.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when the product falls within BSTI energy-labelling coverage
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory China label evidence where GB 18613 and China labelling rules apply domestically

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] A China energy label is not a Bangladesh label. Prepare a BSTI-facing label and efficiency evidence pack if the imported motor is covered.

rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh is a developing market and enforcement levels can vary by product, port, programme maturity and inspection practice. Exporters should still treat BSTI efficiency and labelling requirements as compliance gates because inconsistent enforcement does not remove legal or customs risk.
target_standards: BSTI conformity and energy labelling programmes
NBR import and customs administration
Applicable BDS standards for covered motors
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance evidence is commonly organized around GB 18613, GB 12665 and CCC for applicable low-voltage motors. China enforcement evidence may demonstrate factory discipline but does not predict Bangladesh port or market-surveillance treatment.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: Do not use variable enforcement as a shipment strategy. The safer route is to pre-clear coverage, certification, label and import evidence with the Bangladesh importer before production lock.

mandatory_status.target: Risk-based mandatory planning where BSTI or import requirements apply
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China GB and CCC requirements apply domestically

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Variable enforcement should be treated as uncertainty, not permission. Build the Bangladesh BSTI and import file before dispatch.

rows.requirement: EMC and Electrical Disturbance Evidence for Industrial Motors
rows.target_requirement: Standalone industrial AC motors may be reviewed mainly through electrical safety, performance and BDS motor standards, while motor-driven systems, variable-speed drives and control panels can raise EMC or power-quality questions. Bangladesh importers should prepare evidence for conducted emissions, immunity, harmonics or installation controls where the motor package includes electronic drives.
target_standards: Applicable BDS or IEC 60034 motor standards
BERC grid and power-quality oversight context
Relevant IEC EMC standards where electronic drives are included
rows.china_equivalent: China motor evidence normally centers on GB 18613, GB 12665 and CCC for low-voltage motors in scope. If the export package includes drives or controllers, Chinese EMC reports may exist under GB or IEC-based EMC standards, but they must be mapped to the Bangladesh configuration.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: A bare motor file may not cover the exported system if a VFD, soft starter or control cabinet is bundled. Bangladesh review should be based on the full delivered configuration, not only the China motor certificate.

mandatory_status.target: Case-dependent; mandatory where BDS, import review, grid connection or bundled electronics requirements apply
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China CCC, GB or EMC requirements apply to the product configuration

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Check EMC and power-quality evidence at system level if the motor is supplied with a drive or controller. China motor-only certificates may be too narrow.

rows.requirement: BTRC Radio or Wireless Functions in Motor Packages
rows.target_requirement: If the motor package includes wireless monitoring, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular telemetry, remote control or radio modules, Bangladesh Telecommunications Regulatory Commission requirements can apply separately from BSTI motor certification. Radio equipment approval should be checked for each embedded or supplied wireless module.
target_standards: BTRC radio and telecommunications equipment approval requirements
BSTI certification where the motor product is covered
Applicable import documentation for radio-enabled equipment
rows.china_equivalent: China motor compliance evidence under GB 18613, GB 12665 and CCC does not address Bangladesh radio approval. China SRRC or other wireless approvals for a module, if present, are separate China-market evidence and are not Bangladesh BTRC approvals.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: Wireless functions create a separate approval track. A compliant industrial motor can still be delayed if the telemetry or remote-control module lacks Bangladesh radio documentation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where radio or wireless equipment is included
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory only for applicable China radio or CCC scope; not transferable to Bangladesh

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Separate the motor approval file from any wireless module approval file. BTRC review may be needed even when BSTI motor certification is otherwise complete.

rows.requirement: BSTI Mandatory Certification for Covered Products
rows.target_requirement: BSTI administers Bangladesh Standards and mandatory product certification for listed covered products. If an industrial motor model is within a covered category, the importer should secure the applicable BSTI conformity certificate or certification route before market placement and, where required, before customs release.
target_standards: BSTI mandatory certification for covered products
Applicable BDS standards for industrial motors
BSTI conformity certificate requirements for listed imported products
rows.china_equivalent: China CCC certificates for low-voltage motors in CCC scope, GB 18613 reports and GB 12665 evidence can support the technical file. They are not recognized as Bangladesh market approvals and should not be presented as substitutes for BSTI certification.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: China CCC is not recognized as a Bangladesh certificate. The immediate market-access task is to confirm whether the motor is listed by BSTI and, if listed, obtain the local conformity certificate before relying on the shipment.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for products listed under BSTI mandatory certification
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where CCC and China GB standards apply in China

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Verify BSTI coverage first. If covered, budget for Bangladesh certification and do not rely on China CCC as market access evidence.

rows.requirement: Import Clearance, Tariffs and Certificate Checks by NBR
rows.target_requirement: The National Board of Revenue administers customs, import duties and tariff treatment. For listed products, a BSTI conformity certificate may be requested during import processing. The importer should align HS code, invoice description, model identity, certificate scope and country-of-origin documents before shipment.
target_standards: NBR customs and tariff administration
BSTI certificate requirements for listed imports
Bangladesh import documentation requirements
rows.china_equivalent: A China export pack commonly includes invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, factory test report, GB 18613 evidence, GB 12665 evidence and CCC where applicable. These documents need Bangladesh import mapping and may need a BSTI certificate for listed products.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The import gap is not only technical. A mismatch between certificate model, HS code, invoice description or physical nameplate can delay release even when the motor design is acceptable.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for customs processing and for listed products requiring BSTI evidence
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory China export documents do not replace Bangladesh import checks

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Align the Bangladesh customs file with the BSTI certificate scope before shipment. China export paperwork alone may not clear a listed motor.

rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh RoHS-related controls should be checked through the BSTI schedule and applicable product coverage, rather than assumed to operate as a standalone EU-style RoHS regime. For motors with electronic components, drives or control boards, restricted-substance declarations may still be requested as part of the product file or buyer requirement.
target_standards: BSTI schedule for applicable product and substance controls
BSTI mandatory certification where product is covered
Buyer or importer restricted-substance documentation requirements
rows.china_equivalent: China motor files may include GB 18613, GB 12665, CCC and supplier material declarations. China RoHS or supplier declarations, if available, are useful supporting documents but are not the same as Bangladesh BSTI schedule coverage.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The gap is classification. Do not copy an EU RoHS compliance route into Bangladesh; check whether the relevant BSTI schedule or buyer contract asks for restricted-substance evidence for the motor or its electronics.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where included in BSTI schedule or import or buyer requirements
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory only where China substance-control rules or buyer requirements apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Bangladesh RoHS as a BSTI-schedule and product-coverage question. Avoid using an EU-style standalone RoHS assumption.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety, Nameplate and Construction Evidence
rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh safety review for covered industrial motors should be built around applicable BDS standards, IEC 60034-derived motor construction and rating expectations, BSTI certification evidence, nameplate marking, insulation, temperature rise, enclosure protection and terminal safety.
target_standards: Applicable BDS motor safety and performance standards
IEC 60034 series as adopted or aligned in BDS
BSTI mandatory certification for covered products
rows.china_equivalent: China low-voltage motor files commonly include CCC certificates where in scope, GB 18613 efficiency evidence and GB 12665 cooling evidence. Factory routine tests and nameplate drawings may support Bangladesh review but do not replace BSTI certification.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The safety gap is local acceptance and model identity. China CCC may show a baseline low-voltage safety process, but Bangladesh needs the exact model, nameplate and BDS/BSTI file for the imported motor.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where BSTI covered-product certification or BDS safety review applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where CCC and China GB standards apply in China

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build the Bangladesh safety file around the exact imported model and BDS or IEC 60034 basis. China CCC is supporting evidence, not Bangladesh approval.

rows.requirement: Grid Voltage Fit and Installation Safety
rows.target_requirement: Bangladesh industrial installations commonly use 400/230 V, 50 Hz three-phase supply. Installation safety should confirm motor voltage range, thermal margin, starting current, protection coordination, earthing, overload protection and compatibility with the connected load and local grid conditions.
target_standards: BERC grid and energy regulatory context
Bangladesh 400/230 V, 50 Hz three-phase supply practice
Applicable BDS or IEC installation and motor safety concepts
rows.china_equivalent: China industrial motors are often rated for 380 V, 50 Hz and supported by GB 18613, GB 12665 and CCC where applicable. The shared 50 Hz frequency helps, but the 380 V to 400 V nominal voltage difference should be addressed in the nameplate, manual and thermal testing evidence.
china_standards: GB 18613 (IE efficiency classes, aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 direction)
GB 12665 (cooling)
CCC for motors below 1 kV where in CCC scope
rows.gap: The practical safety gap is voltage tolerance and installation documentation. A 380 V China motor may be acceptable only if its declared range and thermal design support Bangladesh 400 V operation under real load conditions.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory practical requirement for safe installation and grid connection
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China rating and CCC or GB requirements apply to the supplied motor

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Frequency is aligned at 50 Hz, but voltage fit still needs evidence. Confirm 400 V operation before treating a China 380 V motor as ready for Bangladesh.
